conclusion: M3DM produced useful bounded evidence by validating the existing worker, syncing the repo/data allowlist, proving CUDA readiness, and catching a dry-run command contract mismatch before paid training. next_action_rationale: Continuing requires a human-approved scope decision: either authorize a source/prompt contract change for an M3DM full-split TCN mode, or issue a new prompt that uses the existing M3AW smoke guard.
